entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: A planeswalker and future Elder Druid of Corondor, partner of Kristina and father of Justina.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Jared's lover who gives birth to their daughter Justina.

entities.name: Justina
entities.description: The daughter of Jared and Kristina.

entities.name: Elder Druid of Corondor
entities.description: A druid with the crescent-moon Mark of the Elder Druid who prepares others for war and tells Jared he must choose between the land and the stars.

entities.name: Yorgo
entities.description: The ruler of the ruins of Arathoxia who brings the druid to Jared.

entities.name: Amadis
entities.description: A Quirion exarch present at Justina's birth.

entities.name: Finovar
entities.description: A Quirion exarch present at Justina's birth.

entities.name: Kadesha
entities.description: A visionary present at Justina's birth.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: A battle mage who recruits allies by deception for the coming war and created the Mox Beacon.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: An isolationist panther warrior and planeswalker of Urborg, whose ancestors came from Efrava.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The place where Lord Windgrace lives and where Ravidel takes a chunk of obsidian.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who comes to protect Corondor and binds Sol'Kanar with the Lord of Khone.

entities.name: Lord of House Khone
entities.description: A lord who hides his soul behind black metal and holds a war council.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar the Swamp King
entities.description: A being summoned and bound so that Ravidel's black magic bolsters Freyalise.

entities.name: Mox Beacon
entities.description: A device created by Ravidel that draws powerful planeswalkers to Corondor.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A dangerous planeswalker drawn by the Mox Beacon.

entities.name: Eskil the White
entities.description: A resident of the White Woods seeking redemption for his ancestor Xarl's crimes.

entities.name: Embereck
entities.description: An Ash Warlord dragged to Corondor by the Mox Beacon who once recovered the Golgothian Sylex.

entities.name: Golgothian Sylex
entities.description: A weapon Embereck recovered and handed to Ravidel, later destroyed by Jared.

entities.name: Daria
entities.description: Taysir's daughter, imprisoned in an Amber Prison on the Null Moon.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Daria's father, who banished Sandruu.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker who persuades Szat to imprison Daria and proposes conquering the world.

entities.name: Amber Prison
entities.description: The prison in which Daria is placed.

entities.name: Null Moon
entities.description: The moon where Daria waits and is imprisoned.

entities.name: Sandruu
entities.description: A minotaur, former lover of Kristina, enraged by Ravidel's manipulation.

entities.name: Grenfell Mor
entities.description: A character who scuffles with Sandruu and Ravidel.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: The land of the coming war.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: The island to which Eskil transports himself and Embereck.

events.summary: The Elder Druid finds Jared with Yorgo's help as Kristina gives birth to Justina, and announces he has come to prepare others for war.
events.quote: Kristina gives birth to a daughter, and they name her Justina .

events.summary: Ravidel visits Urborg and fails to convince Lord Windgrace, an isolationist, to join him; he takes a chunk of obsidian.
events.quote: Ravidel leaves, not able to convince the panther warrior .

events.summary: Freyalise appears at the Lord of Khone's war council and the two summon and bind Sol'Kanar the Swamp King.
events.quote: Freyalise and the Lord of Khone summon Sol'Kanar the Swamp King and bind him.

events.summary: Embereck destroys Eskil's hut, thinking Eskil summoned him.
Eskil takes Embereck to New Argive, where Embereck tells of recovering the Golgothian Sylex and showing mercy to Ravidel.
events.quote: This convinced the more powerful planeswalker to hand over the Sylex to the Battle Mage.

events.summary: Eskil reveals Ravidel created the Mox Beacon, and Embereck agrees to fight him.
Szat and Leshrac arrive on the Null Moon and put Daria in an Amber Prison instead of killing her.
events.quote: So instead he puts the girl in an Amber Prison .

events.summary: Ravidel enrages Sandruu with out-of-context images of Jared and Kristina, sending him to find Jared.
events.quote: This is enough to send Sandruu into a rage

events.summary: The Elder Druid tells Jared he must choose between the land and the stars.
events.quote: The druid tells Jared that he must choose between the land and the stars.

relations.note: Her lover and father of her child.
relations.quote: Jared, who is minding his lover Kristina
waiting for her father Taysir to arrive
he would be a great ally against Jared Carthalion
it was Ravidel who created it
She promises him that his secrets are safe with her.

relations.note: They arrive together on the Null Moon with a shared history.
relations.quote: Tevesh Szat , the Doom of Fools, and Leshrac , Walker of Night.
